name: How Visual Novels Changed My Life
source:
Between « mise en abyme » and meta-fiction, the game tells the story of…the Träumendes Mädchen team trying desperately to join Nanoreno three weeks before it begins. Inspired by actual conversations and actual people (who aren’t like that in real life, promise !), you can now experiment the frightening blank page syndrome...and a lot of nonsense.

[Created for the Nanoreno 2014]
translation:
在“戏中戏”与元小说之间，游戏讲述了……Träumendes Mädchen团队在Nanoreno开始前三周拼命争取参赛资格的故事。灵感来自真实的对话和真实的人（他们现实中才不是这样，真的！），你可以亲身体验可怕的空白页综合征……以及大量胡闹。

[为Nanoreno 2014制作]
